filing.text_data: I have a rock quarry and a ready mix concrete production facility on the island of Kauai in Hawaii. I extensively use three DJI enterprise grade drones to create photogrammetry mosaics to model my facilities. The most extensive use is the multiple times monthly ground modeling I do to build blasting plans and to measure changes throughout the quarry. The DJI flight controllers automate the flying and image capture process, which I find indispensable. I have not found that kind of capability in other vendor offerings. Since we are 85% (at least) of the crushed rock and concrete production on Kauai, and since my DJI tools have been a significant productivity booster, we would be unreasonably impacted by regulations denying us access to this DJI enterprise grade technology. Please accept this comment as my strong recommendation to let us continue having unfettered access to DJI tools and technology so we can maintain the enhanced productivity we rely upon.
